description: This Java class serves as a wrapper around database update operations, providing methods to retrieve unrun database changes, check if the database is locked, and determine if updates are required. It interacts with the DatabaseUpdater utility and LiquibaseProvider to perform these operations.

classes.name: DatabaseUpdaterWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that provides simplified access to database update operations in OpenMRS.

methods.name: getUnrunDatabaseChanges
methods.description: Returns a list of database change sets that have not yet been applied, using a LiquibaseProvider.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Checks whether the database is currently locked from updates.

methods.name: updatesRequired
methods.description: Determines if there are any pending database updates that need to be applied.
